class.name: GodotDoctorSceneReport
class.brief_description: Holds validation results for a single scene, aggregated from its node reports.

method.name: _init
method.description: Creates a new [GodotDoctorSceneReport] for the scene at [param scene_path] with the given [param node_reports].

method.name: get_num_infos
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.INFO]-level validation messages across all nodes in this scene.

method.name: get_num_warnings
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.WARNING]-level validation messages across all nodes in this scene.

method.name: get_num_errors
method.description: Returns the total number of [constant ValidationCondition.Severity.ERROR]-level validation messages across all nodes in this scene.

method.name: get_validation_messages
method.description: Returns all validation messages across all nodes in this scene.

method.name: get_node_reports
method.description: Returns all node reports within this scene.

method.name: get_scene_path
method.description: Returns the resource path of this scene.

members.member: The resource path of the validated scene.
The list of node reports for all validated nodes within this scene.
